notes.title: New version 0.6
notes.content:
[b]NEW CONTENT[/b]
• New Environmental Climate Added 
• Added Snow And Fog
• New Main Menu Look

_But don't get too confident yet! Surprises await you along the way. Good luck, you'll need it.
